messages:
marta: Heads-up: we're publishing the deprecation plan and migration checklist for the upcoming strict_output default. This thread tracks docs + SDK owner tasks.

eric: Short summary?

marta: Default behavior change for generation endpoints: platform will start enforcing schema validation by default for new keys in 60 days. Opt-in available now via `strict_output=true`.

linh: Why now?

marta: Customers hit silent schema regressions; we want deterministic failures rather than silent downstream bugs. Also improves our ability to detect regressions.

zoe-docs: Docs published (staged): https://internal.redwood.com/docs/strict-output-deprecation. Includes quickstarts for py/js/go, migration checklist, and sample rollback patterns.

devex-bot: release-note: py-sdk@2.4.x, js-sdk@4.3.x, go-sdk@0.9.x add `strict_output` and `validation_mode`.

eric: Migration checklist for SDK owners?

marta: Minimal checklist:
- Add opt-in snippets to README and quickstarts (due 5d).
- Add CHANGELOG entry and call out behavior matrix (coerce vs error).
- Add CI snippet to run the strict-output eval job on your prompts.

linh: Rollout timeline?

marta: Today: opt-in. 30d: dev SDKs default to coerce. 60d: new keys default to strict_output+error. 180d: begin legacy removal window with final notice 30d prior.

eric: Risk: customers that rely on malformed outputs.

marta: Mitigations: coerce mode, staged rollout, CS outreach for detected fragile tenants, and monitoring in Console.

zoe-docs: Action items for docs team: publish staged guide, add code samples, create FAQ entry "my app started erroring".

devex-bot: telemetry: new fields validation_time_ms, validation_result, validation_warnings.

eric: Anything to flag for support?

marta: Yes: support playbook + canned email for tenants; we'll surface top affected customers via usage signals.

linh: I'll schedule a sign-off sync next week with Product + Security + Runtime.

marta: Thanks all. Please post any follow-ups on the staged doc page.
